The government announced on the 3rd that it will relocate essential administrative agencies to the metropolitan area, including the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family. The relocation plan is part of a broader effort to decentralize government functions and improve regional innovation cities. The relocation plan for public institutions will be announced in the fourth quarter of this year and the relocation of the Presidential Office and the National Police Agency will be completed by 2027.

Han Seung-sook, the Prime Minister, and the Ministers of Justice and Gender Equality and Family, Ri Ho-jung, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and Huh Chang, the second Minister of Finance and Economy, attended the Government Conference on the Government Organization Reform.

He added that the relocation of the Presidential Office and the National Police Agency will be completed by 2027.
